pages.text: $(l)Baboons$() move in troops of twenty. They will swap food with you from their cheeks.$(br2)A baboon alone runs. A baboon near its troop screams, and then there are twenty of them. Take the stragglers.

$(l)The big hyena$() follows. Quietly, at a distance, for as long as it takes someone to stop looking.$(br2)Look behind you. If you see it, face it and make noise - it would rather eat someone who never turned round.
$(l)The saber-tooth$() does not care about you, until you are close.$(br2)It will not be frightened off. Keep your distance, keep near a tree, and do not follow it into the grass.
